metadata.title: Mid-Century Studio Session Album Cover
useCases: Vintage jazz or soul album covers

retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century recording studio aesthetic featuring a candid central portrait framed by bold, yellow condensed sans-serif typography and technical studio equipment.
excludeWhen: modern digital clean aesthetics are required
high-contrast black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a centered, candid portrait of a musician in a dark suit, set within a dimly lit recording studio. The layout is defined by heavy, bright yellow condensed typography at the top and bottom, with technical elements like a vintage condenser microphone and sheet music providing environmental context.
coreVisualRelationships: Bright yellow typography contrasting against a dark, moody studio background
Subject centered between upper display title and lower tracklist blocks
Technical studio equipment (microphone, boom arm) framing the subject on the left
Warm, low-key lighting on the subject's face against a deep blue/black suit
coreInvariants: Condensed sans-serif typeface in high-visibility yellow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician is centered, waist-up, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and the bright yellow title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top title, moves down to the subject's face, then splits to the tracklist blocks at the bottom left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark studio shadows provide negative space that makes the yellow text and the subject's face pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal (studio background and suit)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and off-white sheet music
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the text and background; low saturation in the environment with high saturation in the type.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to dark blues, blacks, warm browns, and bright yellow.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point is tall and thin to match character height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales for title and tracklist.
graphicDevices: Rectangular logo frame with rounded corners for secondary metadata

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, sans-serif impact of the title.
Captures the mid-century Swiss-style condensed aesthetic.
Provides the correct vintage grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a smiling man in a dark navy suit sitting at a recording studio desk with sheet music. Include a vintage silver condenser microphone on a boom arm in the upper left. The lighting should be warm on the face and dark in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large title in bold yellow extra-condensed sans-serif at the top. Add two blocks of smaller yellow condensed text in the bottom left and bottom right corners to simulate a tracklist.

verificationChecks: Is the main title in an extra-condensed uppercase sans-serif?
Is the subject a musician in a studio setting?
Are there two distinct text blocks at the bottom?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the yellow is consistent across all text elements.
Verify the microphone looks like a vintage studio model.
Confirm the layout maintains a square aspect ratio.
recipe.reuseFormula: Candid Studio Portrait + Condensed Yellow Sans-Serif + Dark Low-Key Lighting = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
